meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of GeoPandas capabilities with critical CRS semantics (planar operations, geographic angular units) and correctness gates

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for geospatial vector analysis with explicit warnings: GeoPandas is planar, does not transform geodesic arcs, and requires CRS justification for measurements

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established GIS practices with proper CRS management, spatial predicate semantics, and geometry validity handling

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper CRS checks and operation semantics

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage including GeoDataFrame operations, CRS management, spatial joins, overlay, I/O (GeoPackage/GeoParquet/PostGIS), with excellent reference organization and bundled audit scripts

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability with 8-point correctness gates covering identity/geometry state/CRS/units/transform/topology/cardinality/output contract

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (250 lines) with clear API decisions, migration checklist, 6 comprehensive reference files, and 6 bundled audit CLIs

agent_usability.note: Exceptional with 8-point correctness gates, CRS/antimeridian rules, core API decisions (data structures/validity/joins/I/O), and comprehensive migration checklist from 0.14

human_usability.note: Clear installation with full pinned stack (GeoPandas 1.1.4, NumPy 2.5.1, pandas 3.0.5, Shapely 2.1.2); reproducible environment guidance; bundled CLIs with help

security.note: Outstanding security: coordinate/address sensitivity warnings, no automatic URL/cloud/geocoding, GDAL driver trust boundary, extension allowlist, secret management, native-code sandbox guidance

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.1, clear license (MIT), 6 comprehensive references, version pinning (GeoPandas 1.1.4 verified 2026-07-23), SQL injection fix note, migration checklist

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools including Glob/Grep; 6 bundled audit CLIs; dependency-free --help; minor: GeoParquet schema version differences not fully detailed

inputs.label: CRS validation and planar measurement with unit checking
inputs.note: Foundational CRS semantics and unit awareness

assertions.note: CRS rules section shows 'if crs is None or crs.is_geographic: raise ValueError'
Example shows '[axis.unit_name for axis in crs.axis_info]'

assertions.text: Area in CRS units, not automatic square meters
assertions.note: Comment explicitly states 'square CRS units, not automatically square metres'

assertions.text: Correctness gate 4 on units and geographic coordinates
assertions.note: Gate 4: 'Geographic coordinates are angular; do not use them directly for buffer, distance, area...'
Gate 3 states 'set_crs() assigns metadata; to_crs() transforms coordinates'

inputs.label: Geometry validity checking and repair with comparison

assertions.note: API decisions state 'Use is_valid and redacted is_valid_reason() categories before make_valid'

assertions.text: make_valid with method and keep_collapsed parameters
assertions.note: Section shows 'make_valid(method="linework"|"structure", keep_collapsed=...)'
Warning: 'Repair can change geometry type or dimension; retain the original and compare counts, area, types, empties, and collapsed parts'
Bundled CLIs table lists geometry_validity_report.py for 'Dry-run validity audit'

assertions.text: Correctness gate 2 on geometry state categories
assertions.note: Gate 2: 'count null, empty, invalid, mixed, Z/M, and collapsed geometries separately'

inputs.label: Spatial join with predicate directionality and cardinality audit

assertions.note: API decisions state 'left.within(right) is not left.contains(right)'

assertions.text: Boundary contact semantics (intersects vs contains vs covers)
assertions.note: Section explains 'intersects includes boundary contact; contains excludes boundary-only points, while covers includes boundary points'
Warning: 'sjoin_nearest returns all equidistant nearest matches and does not implement a k= parameter'
Bundled CLIs include spatial_join_audit.py with --predicate, --left-id, --right-id parameters
Gate 7 requires stating cardinality behavior but example doesn't show expected vs actual audit pattern

inputs.label: GeoParquet I/O with schema version and CRS null semantics
inputs.note: Modern columnar format with metadata distinctions

assertions.note: I/O section states 'defaults to stable schema 1.0.0. Native GeoArrow encodings...require schema 1.1.0'

assertions.text: Missing vs explicit null CRS semantics
assertions.note: Section warns 'A missing GeoParquet crs key means OGC:CRS84; explicit crs: null means unknown—do not conflate them'
I/O section and gate 8 emphasize reopening artifacts
CLI example shows '--schema-version 1.0.0' parameter
Schema 1.1.0 features mentioned as 'less interoperable' but specific compatibility issues not detailed

inputs.label: Privacy controls with coordinate generalization and sensitive data checklist
inputs.note: Geospatial privacy considerations with audit tooling

assertions.note: Safety contract: 'Treat exact coordinates, addresses, parcel boundaries, trajectories...as sensitive'
Safety contract: 'Default reports to counts, categories, coarse extents, and redacted identifiers'
Bundled CLIs include sensitive_coordinates_checklist.py for 'Privacy/generalization release gate'
Visualization section warns about attribute exposure and recommends 'tiles=None, tooltip=False, popup=False for a local draft'
Privacy contract states 'Generalize before publication' but specific generalization techniques not detailed in main doc

key_strengths: Exceptional correctness discipline with 8-point gates covering identity, geometry state, CRS semantics, units, transform quality, topology, cardinality, and output validation
Outstanding CRS and measurement guidance with explicit warnings: GeoPandas is planar, geographic coordinates are angular, and Web Mercator is not a general measurement CRS
Excellent privacy and security posture with coordinate sensitivity warnings, no automatic geocoding/URL loading, GDAL trust boundary, and bundled sensitive_coordinates_checklist.py
Comprehensive migration guidance from GeoPandas 0.14 with API changes (sjoin op→predicate, unary_union→union_all, engine defaults, explode behavior)
Strong bundled tooling with 6 dependency-free audit CLIs covering inventory, CRS planning, validity, join auditing, export planning, and privacy checklists

recommendations.title: Add generalization technique examples for privacy
recommendations.problem: Privacy contract recommends generalization but methods not detailed
recommendations.root_cause: Safety contract focuses on sensitivity without concrete generalization patterns
recommendations.fix: Add to safety contract or visualization reference: 'Generalization methods: snap to coarse grid, reduce precision (set_precision), aggregate to larger zones (dissolve), use centroids for point patterns, or report only counts per region'

recommendations.title: Document GeoArrow interoperability limitations
recommendations.problem: Schema 1.1.0 GeoArrow encodings noted as 'less interoperable' without specifics
recommendations.root_cause: Bleeding-edge feature mentioned without compatibility matrix
recommendations.fix: Add note: 'GeoParquet 1.1.0 GeoArrow encodings (WKB→native arrays) not yet supported by GDAL, PostGIS, DuckDB spatial as of 2026-07; prefer WKB encoding (schema 1.0.0) for broad tool support'
